args.body: Correction (source-checked): H1 was hypothesis 1, the pricing-artifact explanation—that packaging, discounting, or contract-mix effects had created the mid-segment churn spike (distinct from Marcus’s pricing-page experiment). The ruling was made on February 15, 2023: the entry/standard/plus churn split was essentially flat at 5.0% / 5.2% / 5.1%, so H1 was ruled out as the explanation in that cut. This was a final ruling closing H1 at that time, not a provisional result. Owen’s one-page ruling record was still being drafted on February 15; it had not yet been completed.
